content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe's competitors, like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle, also have limited global reach. Gumroad operates in 42 countries, while Lemon Squeezy serves 34. Paddle covers 36. Each platform offers a unique set of features, but they all share one thing in common: they don't work in many countries where digital creators need them most. PayPal, on the other hand, is available in 200 countries but can freeze funds for up to 180 days without warning, rendering it useless for many digital sellers. Meanwhile, NOWPayments, a payment processor that works with cryptocurrencies, offers a 0.5% fee and doesn't require KYC or buyer accounts. But it's not a direct replacement for Stripe's services, as it doesn't offer the same level of payment processing and automation.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Each platform handles restricted countries differently, but none of them truly address the infrastructure problem at hand. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy suggest creating a business in a country where they do operate, while Paddle recommends using a third-party payment processor. PayPal, on the other hand, freezes funds without warning, leaving digital sellers in a precarious financial situation. In contrast, NOWPayments has no country restrictions and allows creators to sell digital products using cryptocurrencies, giving them a level of infrastructure sovereignty they can't find elsewhere.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, each platform has its own set of trade-offs. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy charge transaction fees between 2.9% and 3.5%, while Paddle charges 2.9% plus $0.30 per transaction. PayPal's fees are notoriously unpredictable, ranging from 2.9% to 4.4%. Meanwhile, NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee, making it a more predictable choice for digital creators. But what about the real costs of using each platform? Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy require creators to handle customer support and refunds, while Paddle recommends using a third-party processor. PayPal, on the other hand, freezes funds without warning, leaving digital sellers with significant financial risks.
Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy require creators to handle customer support and refunds, adding significant time and financial costs.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to ownership, automation, and delivery, each platform has its own set of limitations. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy require creators to handle customer support and refunds, while Paddle recommends using a third-party processor. PayPal, on the other hand, freezes funds without warning, leaving digital sellers with significant financial risks. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a complete commerce infrastructure that includes automated payment processing, instant delivery, and full data ownership. Creators can deploy this stack in 48 hours and load up to 5 products, configuring SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for added security.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When choosing a platform, digital creators need to consider their specific situation and infrastructure needs. If they're looking for a simple way to sell digital products, Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy might be a good choice. But if they need more control over their infrastructure, including automated payment processing and instant delivery, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a better option. And if they want to avoid country restrictions altogether, NOWPayments is the way to go. Ultimately, the right choice depends on the creator's specific needs and goals.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
NOWPayments offers a 0.5% fee and doesn't require KYC or buyer accounts, making it a more attractive option for digital creators.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
